notes.title: Demo Available Now
notes.content:
[h1]See you at Steam Next Fest[/h1]
Johnny is chainsawing away to February 2023 Steam Next Fest! The demo is about 10-15 minutes and covers a few early levels. Later levels in the full release will be longer these initial ones, but this gives you an idea of how the "No Jump Button" controls function. 

Those interested in the story, please do check out Story Mode!

This game is near the end of development, but I am open to any feedback to make this game even better on its launch! Please do reach out to me!

You can give me feedback on the Steam's forum or hop in Johnny's discord here:

https://discord.gg/buMb7x6Pqw

If you enjoy the demo, please wishlist and follow the game!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/711840/Johnny_Chainsaw/

notes.title: Steam Next 2023 and Release Timeline
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

Just a couple quick announcements as 2023 gets closer:

[h2]Steam Next Fest[/h2]
Johnny Chainsaw will be at [b]Steam Next Fest February 2023[/b]. 

Being at Next Fest is a HUGE privilege and I'm grateful to have a chance to show this off to new people. If you have followed along from the beginning or from a recent Con, I would love to have you try out the most updated demo that will be at Next Fest. If this is your first time playing, I'm excited to chat with you and have you try out the demo. 

There are two broadcast slots for Steam Next. I haven't decided which ones I'll be using, I will make an announcement about that once a decision is made.

[h2]Release Schedule[/h2]
I'm aiming for a [b]late March 2023[/b] release. 

If this gets pushed back, it won't be by much. There's some summer games coming out in May (looking at you Tears of the Kingdom) that I don't want to overtake this launch.

[h2]Follow Along[/h2]
If you want to follow along on socials or discord, check out my [url=linktr.ee/johnny_ch]linktree[/url]

[h2]Special Thanks[/h2]
There have been a lot of people who helped me get to this point with playtesting and feedback. I want to acknowledge how awesome you all are and say thank you to everyone who has been a part of this journey:
[list]
[*]2D Con 2021
[*]Midwest Gaming Classic 2021
[*]CoMo Retro Game Con 2022
[*]RTX 2022
[/list]
